mode.demo: Demo mode. Flights and prices are sample data, and bookings are simulated and not valid for travel.
mode.test: Sandbox mode. Results come from a supplier test environment and do not reflect real schedules or fares.
mode.offline: The flight service is unreachable right now.

home.title: Find your next horizon.
home.lede: Compare flights by what they actually cost you: price, travel time, stops and bags, side by side, with every fee shown before you book.

footer.disclaimer: Flight availability and pricing come from connected providers. Demo bookings are not valid for travel.
footer.positioning: AeroNova is a flight discovery and booking technology demonstration, not a licensed travel agency.
